description: Eurostat zeevaart; overgeslagen gewicht naar haven, richting, verschijningsvorm en soort lading (vanaf 01-01-2014) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS Microdata. Dit dataontwerp beschrijft de kenmerken van de inkomende en uitgaande schepen in de Nederlandse havens. Het gaat hierbij om de soort lading, gewicht van laden of lossen, reis van het schip etc. De scheepskenmerken en de reizen zijn afkomstig van Dirkzwager. De gegevens over de geladen en geloste goederen zijn afkomstig van de douane. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS Microdata. Its tags are DGA, Data Governance Act, Microdata, ODISSEI. The portal shows 2024-11-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is no open licence (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
